choices.why: A three-seat rolled-arm sofa in dark fabric with turned legs is the closest to the requested dark velvet sofa and suits a classic room.
Two matching deep armchairs in the same dark fabric and turned legs as the sofa make a coordinated facing pair.
The large traditional medallion rug in dark grey and cream is big enough for the whole group and fits the muted palette.
The dark wood X-base table is classic, and its size suits the space between the sofa and the fireplace.
This is the widest framed mirror, with a traditional geometric gold frame that suits the chimney breast.
The turned-column floor lamp with a linen shade has a classic look and warm tones that go with the room.

answer.why: The dark upholstered sofa and matching armchairs form a cohesive classic seating group. The dark wood table, the traditional rug, the gold-framed mirror and the turned lamp add warm, elegant accents against the pale blue-green walls.
